query: How long do I have to cancel an order after placing it?
reference_answer: You can change or cancel free within 2 hours of ordering, from "My Orders".

query: what does an order number look like? i can't find mine
reference_answer: Order numbers are "LF-" followed by six digits, e.g. LF-204518.

query: Can I change the shipping address after my order has shipped?
reference_answer: No. The address can't be changed after shipping, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy.

query: I'm 16, can I make an account?
reference_answer: No. Customers must be 18 or older to hold an account.

query: Do gift notes cost extra? How long can they be?
reference_answer: Gift notes are free and printed, up to 200 characters. Prices are never printed on gift packing slips.

query: Do plants come in decorative pots?
reference_answer: Plants ship in plastic nursery pots with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately unless the listing says "potted".

query: How many days do I have to return a pot?
reference_answer: Non-living items like pots can be returned within 30 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging.

query: Can I send back a plant because I changed my mind?
reference_answer: No. Live plants can't be returned for change of mind. Plant problems go through the Plant Care Guarantee or Damaged on Arrival.

query: How long is the return label valid?
reference_answer: Prepaid return labels expire after 7 days, so drop the parcel off within 7 days.

query: What's the fee if I return something just because I don't like it?
reference_answer: Change-of-mind returns cost a flat $6.95, deducted from the refund. It's free for Leafy Plus members.

query: Can I return an opened bag of potting soil?
reference_answer: Not unless it's faulty. Opened soil or fertiliser can't be returned otherwise.

query: Can I swap my pot for a bigger one directly?
reference_answer: No direct exchanges. Return the item and place a new order.

query: How fast do refunds come after you get my return?
reference_answer: Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse, to the original payment method.

query: how much is standard shipping?
reference_answer: Standard is $7.95, free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax).

query: Is express shipping free with Leafy Plus?
reference_answer: No. Express is $14.95 and never free, including for Leafy Plus members.

query: What days do live plants ship?
reference_answer: Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. Plant orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the next Monday.

query: Extra charge for a really tall plant?
reference_answer: XL plants (usually over 4 ft) add a $20 handling fee and ship Standard only.

query: Do you ship to Canada?
reference_answer: No. Leafy does not ship internationally.

query: Can I send a plant to a PO box?
reference_answer: No. PO boxes are for non-living items only; live plants can't go to PO boxes.

query: My tracking hasn't updated in 4 business days. What now?
reference_answer: Contact support. We'll open a courier investigation of up to 5 business days. If lost, you choose a free replacement or a full refund.

query: How long is the plant guarantee?
reference_answer: 30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members on plants ordered while the membership is active.

query: Do I need to mail back my dead plant to claim the guarantee?
reference_answer: No. The plant doesn't need to be sent back. Claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up).

query: One of my plant's older leaves went yellow after a week. Is that covered?
reference_answer: Not on its own. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress.

query: How long until a specialist reviews my guarantee claim?
reference_answer: A Plant Care Specialist reviews within 2 business days.

query: How long do I have to report a plant that arrived with a snapped stem?
reference_answer: Within 48 hours of delivery, with photos of the item and the box.

query: Is a few loose soil and some bent leaves considered damage?
reference_answer: No. A few bent leaves or loose soil is normal and not damage.

query: You sent me the wrong plant. Do I have to send it back?
reference_answer: No. A wrong live plant can be kept at no charge, and we ship the correct item free by Express where the zone allows.

query: My $25 pot arrived cracked. Do I need to return it?
reference_answer: Items under $40 usually don't need to be sent back. You'll get a replacement or refund; report within 48 hours with photos.

query: What payment methods do you take? Can I pay by bank transfer?
reference_answer: Credit and debit cards, digital wallets at checkout, and Leafy gift cards. No cash, cheques or bank transfers. Buy-now-pay-later is available on $50–$1,000 orders.

query: When is my card actually charged?
reference_answer: Cards are authorised at checkout and charged when the order ships.

query: I cancelled my order but there's still a pending charge. When will it go away?
reference_answer: A pending authorisation on a cancelled order drops off in 3–7 business days depending on the bank. Leafy can't release it faster.

query: Can you refund me to a different card than I paid with?
reference_answer: No. Refunds go only to the original payment method. Alternatively you can take Leafy store credit, issued instantly.

query: How long does a refund take to hit a digital wallet?
reference_answer: Digital wallet refunds take 3–5 business days (cards 5–10 business days, store credit instant).

query: The price dropped 3 days after I bought. Can I get the difference?
reference_answer: Yes, within 7 days of purchase the difference is given as store credit, once per item, excluding flash sales and clearance.

query: Can I use two promo codes on one order?
reference_answer: No. One promo code per order, and it can't be added after ordering.

query: Do gift cards expire? Can I cash one out?
reference_answer: Gift cards ($25–$500) never expire and are not refundable for cash.

query: How much is the Collector plan?
reference_answer: Collector is $49/month (medium or rare plant, 6-inch pot).

query: When does Plant Club bill me?
reference_answer: On the 25th of the previous month; boxes ship in the first full week of the month.

query: Can I pick which plant I get in Plant Club?
reference_answer: No, it's a surprise, but you can list up to 3 plants you own to avoid duplicates.

query: Is there a fee to cancel Plant Club?
reference_answer: No cancellation fee or minimum term. An already-billed box is not refunded and is still sent.

query: How long can I pause my subscription?
reference_answer: Up to 3 months, from "Account" > "Subscriptions".

query: What does Leafy Plus cost and what do I get?
reference_answer: $59/year, auto-renews: free Standard shipping with no minimum, free change-of-mind returns, 90-day guarantee, 10% off pots and accessories, early access to rare drops. No free Express.

query: I just joined Leafy Plus yesterday and haven't used anything. Can I get a refund?
reference_answer: Yes. A full refund is available if cancelled within 14 days of purchase or renewal and no benefits have been used.

query: Do you have a phone number I can call?
reference_answer: No phone support. Use chat (8am–8pm Mon–Sat) or email help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day).

query: When are the plant specialists available on chat?
reference_answer: 9am–5pm Mon–Fri, in your local time. Anyone can get free care advice by chat or email.

query: My dog chewed a pothos leaf!
reference_answer: Contact your vet or local poison control immediately. Pothos is not pet-safe. We'll then escalate to a Support Lead.

query: What's the most you can give me as goodwill credit for a late delivery?
reference_answer: Agents can offer a one-time store credit of up to $15; more needs a Support Lead. Goodwill is never cash.

query: Can you change the email on my account for me?
reference_answer: No. Support can't change an account email over chat; you change it yourself after logging in.

query: Is a calathea safe for cats?
reference_answer: Yes, calathea is on the pet-safe list (along with spider plant, parlour palm, Boston fern, peperomia).

query: When can I repot my new plant, and how often should I water?
reference_answer: Don't repot for 2–3 weeks, and keep out of direct sun the first week. Water only when the top inch of soil is dry.
